name: Short Walk Ideas
description: Light ideas for a short stroll, indoors or out, while your agents work.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ideas for a short walk, one at a time, shown on Away Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. A few steps is enough.
howToPlay: Head away from your desk and read the idea.
Press Another idea for a different one.
Press Back at desk when you return.
tips: Walk at a pace and distance that suits you today. Ideas are only suggestions.
